notes:
Summary: Large marketplace (catalog + transaction logs) — moving from a hybrid ES + vector stack to a single semantic retrieval layer with reranking. Primary goal: reduce user-perceived latency and cut unit cost for discovery queries at scale. Current index size estimate: 250M product/item vectors (embedding dim 1536), growth to ~800M within 12–18 months.

Key requirements (from GTM/Infra/ML):
- QPS target: sustained 1,500 qps peak (search traffic), spiky bursts to 6k qps for promotions.
- P95 end-to-end (embed+search+rerank) latency target: <= 200ms; target for pure retrieval step P95: <= 100ms.
- Cost sensitivity: aim to reduce per-query embedding+search cost by ~60% vs current hosted vendor.
- Reranking: lightweight cross-encoder on top-K=50, but want fallback to cheaper lexical+approximate rerank for low-value queries.
- Availability/SLA: 99.95% required for primary regions.
- Data controls: must support EU residency for product and user data; strong audit logs; SSO integration.

Technical notes from calls: 
- They're evaluating Dedicated pools in us-east + eu-west and private deployment for EU-residency.
- Interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions: batching strategies, hybrid quantization profiles (int8 for base retrieval, int4 for cold shards), and persistent KV cache for hot prefixes.
- Main ask: run a 72-hour POC on Dedicated with a 250M-vector index, simulate promo bursts, measure cost / p95 / throttling behavior.
- Quote from Head of Search (call 2026-02-10): "If we can hit sub-150ms P95 at 2k sustained qps and show 40–60% savings, procurement will fast-track this."

POC scope / acceptance criteria: 
- Build and serve 250M embeddings (1536-dim) on Dedicated; demonstrate ingest throughput of >= 50k vectors/hour for initial backfill.
- Retrieval P95 <= 100ms for K=10; end-to-end P95 <= 200ms including rerank for K=50 on typical queries.
- Cost model: show projected cost per query at 250M / 500M / 1B scales with recommended batching and cache enabled.
- Failover: automatic fallback to cheaper model variant with <20% degradation to top-5 MRR under heavy load.

Recent timeline (bulleted):
- 2026-01-15: Intro call (Avery) — discovered scale and compliance needs.
- 2026-01-22: Architecture deep-dive with Infra + ML (Liam) — mapped ingestion pipeline and sharding ideas.
- 2026-02-03: Security questionnaire submitted; awaiting KMS/HSM spec.
- 2026-02-10: POC kickoff (Fireflies ff_2026-02-10_emerald_poc_kickoff).
- 2026-02-24: Mid-POC perf review; identified cold-shard latency spikes, suggested persistent KV + hot-shard placement. (ff_2026-02-24_perf_review)

Next steps (short):
- Engineering: schedule 72-hr Dedicated run w/ simulated traffic (owner: Liam).
- Security: provide HSM integration spec and confirm encryption at rest key lifecycle (owner: Maya).
- Commercial: draft 2-tier pricing (250M entry, 1B enterprise) and SLA; send preliminary quote by 2026-03-05.

Open questions / risks: 
- Exact growth cadence — if reach 1B in 6 months vs 18 months changes hardware plan and cost.
- Customer may request on-prem during procurement which requires air-gap packaging (higher TCO).
- Interop with their existing ES-based fallback flow — need clear migration plan to avoid search regressions.
